purpose: Ground-truth overlap events for separating Bertazzoni oven and dishwasher signatures from P1 phase data. Reference-only; not yet used for automatic attribution.

events.interpretation: Strong combined-load reference. L1 and L2 both show ~2 kW net import while L3 remains exporting. Because dishwasher and Bertazzoni oven overlap, this sample must not be used to assign the full ~4.0 kW house candidate to either appliance individually. Use it only as overlap evidence when compared with future clean single-appliance ON/OFF transitions.

implementation_rule: Do not auto-attribute this overlap event to either appliance. Require at least one clean Bertazzoni-only transition and one clean dishwasher-only transition, preferably with direct P1 phase samples before/after the transition, then solve the overlap as a residual consistency check.
architecture_note: Use direct Homey P1 readings for short fingerprint calibration windows; do not increase continuous Homey polling load solely for fingerprinting.
